record.text: Getting somewhere good with the family for iPhone Duo. Making great progress each day in the various poses and orientations - and more than anything, really excited to hold and use this thing in the hand!

Competitors aped the screens aspect ratio before the iPhone Duo was announced, but they didn’t do the work that Apple did in order to arrive at the conclusion why this aspect ratio is exactly right, what user experience it enables, and how such a device should work from the software standpoint.[3/5]

A cynic would say that the iPhone Duo invents little to no new things. Foldable smartphones have existed for almost a decade. Most of the software features and ideas that iPhone Duo uses have been tried before by other companies. [1/5]

The iPhone Duo may be the most interesting iPhone buying decision Apple has given us in years. This isn’t a review—I haven’t touched one yet—but I already know which way I’m leaning.

In this video, I explain why the new interface and larger folding screen have me willing to give up the better camera, take a chance on first-generation hardware, and spend a lot of money for what could essentially become an iPad mini in my pocket. I also look at the trade-offs and who should probably stick with the iPhone Pro instead.

The iPhone 18 Pro series features a variable aperture camera, a 2nm A20 Pro chip, a smaller Dynamic Island, and advanced AI features in iOS 27. The iPhone Duo includes a 7.6-inch foldable inner display and multitasking capabilities, utilizing Apple's custom C2 modem for high performance and power efficiency.
